title: Widgets
lead: Use literal key/value content in fixed template positions or reusable ordered sets.

sections.title: Template positions
steps: Open Widgets → New widget. For example, select an available footer position and write a short plain-text message; save and inspect the public template.
Overview lists positional widgets. Create one by selecting a key discovered from the active template manifest, then enter a plain value and description.
Existing records remain preserved when the active template does not declare their positions. Global identity and contact defaults continue to belong to Global Settings.

sections.title: Reusable content
steps: Open Reusable widgets to create stable keys independent of template positions. Values are plain text. Descriptions can label the content in a rendered set.
Write direct plugin references in HTML/code. The Core resolves them automatically; existing saved bindings remain compatible.
Edit a reusable record or set from its list. For example, create two records, add them to a set named example-highlights and move a member up or down before saving.

sections.title: Recovery and safety
steps: Move positional widgets, reusable records or sets to Trash instead of deleting them permanently. Restore them from Trash or restore the catalog from History.
Trashed members are omitted publicly while their references remain recoverable. Exports include live content only. Values never execute HTML, PHP, JavaScript or nested component markers.

sections.title: Raw reusable values and sets
steps: widgets:records(key: set key) returns ordered live items with key, value, description. widgets:value(key: reusable widget key) returns a single value. widgets:set remains compatible with template-owned card/list formats. Positional widget keys remain supported. Returned values are plain escaped text and are never reinterpreted as Mustache.

Bind widgets:records with alias highlights and write {{#highlights.items}}

{{description}}

{{value}}

{{/highlights.items}}. Bind widgets:value with alias notice and use {{notice.value}}. Reusable sets do not require template location keys; positional widgets still use locations declared by the active template.

sections.title: Direct plugin data and template positions
body: Create a reusable widget with an immutable key. Choose Text for escaped text, HTML for validated markup, or JSON for structured values. Reference by record ID or key. Use .value for text, .data.<field> for JSON; a standalone HTML widget reference inserts its validated fragment. Returned text/HTML is never expanded again as Mustache.
steps: Use the stable identifier or slug without dots. Explicit id.<value> and slug.<value> selectors disambiguate reserved names.
Place named query parameters before field paths; use sections (#) and inverted sections (^) for finite iteration and empty states.
Keep presentation in the receiving layout. Template positions require manifest declarations and source-plugin assignments.
